Zoe Park: quick note 1 ran int4 canary for q7c with the new 'edge-split' ingest augment enabled. We see a concentrated regression on interleaved prompts where an appended example contains an inline code fence.

Zoe Park: run excerpt:
```
run_id: q7c-int4-177111
examples: 1,100
mismatch_rate: 0.049
cluster: edge-split (interleaved + code-fence), signals=[ordering, code_truncation, punctuation_shift]
```

Hector Ruiz: is edge-split the augment that splits multi-turns into interleaved snippets or the variant that inserts synthetic clarifiers?

Zoe Park: interleaved snippets (edge-split v0.4). It inserts small clarifying examples between turns and trims an extra newline. That newline trim seems to interact with tokenizer-suffix heuristics.

Anya Petrov: can you paste 2 sanitized failing prompts (short) and the fp16 vs int4 symptom? helps rule out golden overlap vs quant drift.

Zoe Park: sanitized examples:
- "User: show config
```yaml
key: val
``` || Insert: clarifier" -> fp16 preserves fenced block, int4 drops final line inside fence
- "System: steps
1) first
2) second || Insert: small note" -> int4 reorders step 2 and cuts trailing punctuation
Both look like token-index drift around fenced-block boundaries after quant path.

runtime-bot: [run] qbench summary: run=q7c-int4-177111 baseline=q7c-fp16-177000 delta_mismatch=+4.9% top_signals=[ordering,code_truncation] link=https://qbench.local/runs/q7c-int4-177111

Hector Ruiz: proposed triage: (A) rerun canary without edge-split to test augmentation isolation, (B) run int4 with `--kernelset=legacy-2026-02` and `--kvcache-trace=on` for 7 failing seeds, (C) assemble a micro-golden of 220 edge-split cases with dedupe + regen mapping.

Anya Petrov: I'll own (C). Plan: generate micro-golden 'edge-split-mini-220', run token-fingerprint dedupe vs main golden, and exclude any regen collisions. I'll attach `sample-stamp` <run>-<seed>-<ts> for each entry and include fp16 vs int4 snippets. ETA 4h.

Hector Ruiz: I'll take (B). I'll collect KV dumps for 7 seeds, include first-256 tokens for diffs, and upload to s3://redwood/qbench/kvdumps/q7c-177111/. If kernel fallback removes the delta, we should add a runtime flag to avoid the new kernel on inputs containing code-fences.

Zoe Park: I'll run (A) now and post the updated qbench link. Muting edge-split from baseline for the rerun.

qbench-bot: [task] INF-1801 created: "q7c-int4: edge-split interleaved/code-fence truncation" assigned to runtime+curation.

Anya Petrov: one extra note for curation: when building the micro-golden include both with/without clarifier variants per seed so we can compare label stability and whether the clarifier causes golden overlap. Also run a light tokenizer-unicode normalization pass to catch ellipsis/collapse edgecases.

Hector Ruiz: small follow-up: add `sample-stamp` to the failing ids export and include regen-id csv in the ticket. Put KV dumps and a short diff script in the ticket so infra can re-run diffs easily.

Zoe Park: thanks team. I'll attach the rerun diffs and edge-split-mini-220 S3 path to INF-1801 once Anya and Hector upload their artifacts. Marking bring-up P1 until we confirm augmentation vs kernel cause. :exclamation:
